events.title: ChatGPT launched
events.summary: A chat UI made LLMs mainstream overnight.

narrative.whyChosen: ChatGPT turned LLMs from an API curiosity into a consumer phenomenon.
narrative.whyImportant: It reset expectations for search, writing, support, coding help, and how quickly AI features would ship everywhere.
narrative.problemSolved: Most people did not want to integrate an API — they wanted a simple conversational interface that just worked.
